title: Keeper Wren refuses a plain request for the Keeper's Key (will check) and it costs Barrow-Keepers standing ('marks that a stranger asked before earning it'); moments later, forcing her locked chest open with a might check, in the same room with her still present, yields the same key, grants +1 Barrow-Keepers standing, and completes the quest literally named 'Keeper Wren's Trust' — with no line from her acknowledging the break-in. The polite path is punished and the forceful one is rewarded as 'trust.'
where: The Keepers' Hall (Hollowbrook) — talking to Keeper Wren vs. 'force the bronze-bound chest'
